# Authorized decryptors for portfolio-app env backups.
#
# Each non-comment line is an `age` recipient: either an SSH public key
# (ssh-rsa / ssh-ed25519, exactly as found in a .pub file) or a native
# `age1...` public key. Only the holder of the matching PRIVATE key can
# decrypt backups encrypted against this list — these are public keys,
# so committing this file is safe.
#
# To add a new machine, see docs/guides/ENV_BACKUP_GUIDE.md
# ("Setting up a new laptop").
